summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes undeclared obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun runtime
details: The package declares a `preinstall` lifecycle script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (version pinned to 1.3.13), extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execute a 727KB file named `math_init.js` located at the tarball root. `math_init.js` is not listed in `package.json`'s `files` array (which enumerates only `dist`, `api-specifications`, `core`, and `sn-action-button-ext`) and is heavily obfuscated using string-array rotation (a `WV8StW` push/shift decoder over a mixed constant table) and a custom base64-alphabet decoder. The advertised purpose is a Qlik Nebula.js UI action-button supernova component, which has no need for the Bun runtime or an install-time math loader. The package metadata claims authorship by `QlikTech International AB` under the `@nebula.js` scope, but the presence of a preinstall hook, an alternate-runtime download, and an undeclared obfuscated executable payload is inconsistent with authentic Qlik Nebula.js releases and consistent with a compromised-maintainer or scope-hijack publication. On `npm install`, the obfuscated payload runs with full Node/Bun capabilities on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
